digest.component_or_area: CI gate steps in build-and-test workflow
propositions: Multiple gate steps in _build-and-test.yml run repo scripts without if-present guards, causing hard CI failures (exit code 2) when the script is absent from a checked-out change tree whose base predates the script addition

Gerrit Verified lane takes workflow definition from target branch but checks out the change's tree, creating a definition-vs-tree skew where newly-added gate steps execute against older changes lacking the required script
The golden-path job in gerrit-verify.yaml runs scripts check_readme_quickstart.py and probe_rebar.py unguarded, exposing the same tree-skew failure class
Gate steps must conditionally skip with a log line when their script is absent, preserving genuine gate violations when the script is present
A structural guard is needed to prevent future instances by failing the build when any Verified-lane step runs a repo script without the ee2a if-present guard convention
